title: Guaropolis Lite
description: Modpack made for low-resource PC players on the Guaropolis server.
body:
Welcome to Guarópolis Lite, a lightweight version of our modpack specially designed for players with low-end PCs, without losing the fun and adventure of the server experience.

This modpack is built to provide the best possible performance, reducing RAM usage and improving FPS while keeping the gameplay stable, smooth, and fully compatible with all Guarópolis features.

What does it include?
- ⚡ Advanced optimizations for better performance.
- 🪶 Lightweight and carefully selected mods.
- 🌍 Full compatibility with the Guarópolis server.
- 🎨 Small visual improvements without affecting FPS.
- 🔧 Stability fixes and gameplay enhancements.
- 📦 A simple and optimized enhanced-vanilla experience.

Recommended Requirements
- 💾 4 GB RAM or higher.
- 🖥️ Basic or mid-range processor.
- ☕ Minecraft Java Edition.

Perfect for players who want to enjoy Guarópolis without needing a powerful computer.
Join now and experience the server with the best possible performance!
